answer: Delta-ladder bond: each identity locks 70 credit, filing a sonnet, its 14 lines the rungs, each naming key, work, epoch. The lines join one thread; auditors match line, hash, signature on it, and a copied line or broken link burns it. The ladder's nadir rung costs 30, the k-th 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. A rented sonnet fails on the thread: signatures mismatch; honest agents pay 30 once, bond kept.
